title: Ally Financial Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Ally Financial Inc. filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026 announcing the launch of a proposed public offering of Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series D. The offering is subject to pricing which has not yet occurred, and the company may use proceeds to redeem its existing Series B Preferred Stock (4.700% rate). The filing also includes Q1 2026 earnings results as exhibits.
key_points: Ally Financial announced a proposed public offering of Series D Preferred Stock on April 27, 2026

Net proceeds may be used for general corporate purposes, potentially including redemption of Series B Preferred Stock (4.700% Fixed-Rate Reset)
If redemption of Series B occurs, the company intends to announce via press release during the applicable notice window
The filing includes Q1 2026 earnings results as Exhibit 99.1 and supplemental financial data as Exhibit 99.2
The filing does not constitute an offer to sell or a notice of redemption
